question: What alternative proportional divisions are permitted for determining the measure?
premises: Half the reference measure is one option.
An intermediate division into an eighth part is possible.
A ninefold division of the measure is also permitted.
inference: The measure may be half, or determined in between by an eighth part, or taken as a ninefold division.
uncertainties: The precise spatial application of antare aṣṭāṃśe is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: The measure may be half, or an intermediate eighth part, or else divided ninefold.
